verdict.strongest_covered_cluster: The canary execution and recovery cluster is strongest: approved production entry, signature verification, 5% launch, all four metrics over consecutive windows, 25%/50%/100% progression, telemetry-unavailable pause, operator rollback, and rollback to the last known-good image are all represented in a connected flow.
verdict.most_consequential_gap: The audit contract is incomplete: approvals, metric decisions, and traffic changes are not shown entering the audit log. Other notable partials are the lack of explicit rollout freezing, incomplete all-gate failure notification semantics, and omission of the actual safe compensating action.
verdict.coverage_summary: Weighted coverage is 61.5 of 71 possible points (P = 0.8662). The board substantially covers the delivery pipeline, staging sequence, canary progression, telemetry failure handling, rollback, active-revision agreement, and operator controls. Coverage falls below the 0.90 anchor because three required audit-event categories are absent and several important qualifiers or responsible components are only partial. No system-defining requirement is absent or contradicted, so no cap applies.
